paragraphs.text: Connecting Businesses, Customers and Communities Through Smarter Delivery
KT COURIERS is a South African marketplace and delivery platform built to make buying, selling and delivering easier, faster and more accessible.

We connect customers, businesses, vendors and delivery partners through one growing digital platform, helping businesses reach more customers while giving consumers convenient access to the products and services they need.
From food and groceries to pharmacy products, e-commerce purchases and parcels, KT Couriers brings different delivery needs together in one convenient marketplace.

We believe delivery should be more than simply moving something from one place to another. It should create opportunities for businesses, income opportunities for people and greater convenience for communities.
Delivering Convenience. Creating Opportunities. Growing Businesses.
Our mission is to build a reliable, technology-driven marketplace that connects businesses with customers while providing efficient delivery solutions.
We aim to help businesses grow their reach, simplify their logistics and access new customers, while making everyday shopping and delivery more convenient for consumers.
Building a Smarter Marketplace for South Africa
Our vision is to become a leading South African marketplace and delivery platform known for innovation, reliability, accessibility and customer satisfaction.

We want to build a platform where businesses of different sizes can participate in the digital economy, customers can conveniently access products and services, and delivery partners can create meaningful earning opportunities.
As we grow, our goal is to expand our marketplace and delivery network while continuing to strengthen the communities and businesses we serve.
KT Couriers brings multiple services together through one platform.
We connect customers with restaurants, food businesses and local food vendors, making it easier to discover and order meals for delivery.
From everyday meals to special occasions, our delivery network is designed to help businesses get their products to customers efficiently.
Customers can access groceries, household essentials and everyday products from participating businesses and have their orders delivered conveniently.
Our goal is to save customers time while helping local businesses reach customers beyond their physical locations.
KT Couriers supports delivery of eligible pharmacy, health and wellness products from participating businesses.

Where prescription medicines or regulated products are involved, orders and deliveries remain subject to the requirements of the relevant pharmacy, healthcare provider and applicable South African laws.
KT Couriers helps businesses participate in online commerce by providing a platform where products can be presented to customers and delivered through our logistics network.
We aim to give businesses an additional digital channel through which they can reach and serve customers.
From personal parcels and documents to business packages, KT Couriers provides delivery solutions for customers and businesses.
Our parcel services are designed around convenience, transparency and reliable collection-to-delivery coordination.
Businesses often need more than traditional consumer deliveries.
KT Couriers supports business-to-business delivery requirements, including scheduled collections, document deliveries, parcels, stock movement and other logistics requirements.
KT Couriers is not simply a delivery company.
We are building a marketplace ecosystem.

Customers & Communities
This creates an ecosystem where businesses can sell, customers can shop and delivery partners can help move products where they need to go.
Our long-term objective is to make KT Couriers a platform where businesses can grow beyond their physical location and customers can discover more products and services in one place.
Technology is at the centre of KT Couriers.
Our platform is designed to simplify the entire delivery journey, from ordering and payment to dispatch and delivery.
Depending on the service being used, customers and businesses can benefit from features such as:
We continuously look for ways to improve our technology and make the platform easier to use.
We believe that small and growing businesses should have access to the same digital opportunities as larger companies.
KT Couriers is therefore designed to help businesses:
Participate in a growing marketplace ecosystem.
Our goal is not simply to deliver products for businesses.
Our goal is to help businesses grow.
KT Couriers is also focused on creating opportunities within the communities we serve.
Through our delivery network, growth initiatives and business-development programmes, we aim to create opportunities for individuals to participate in the digital economy.
We believe that when businesses grow, communities can grow with them.
From placing an order to receiving it, we aim to provide a professional and reliable experience.
We work to provide dependable delivery and marketplace services.
We make it easier for customers to access products and services.
We use technology to continually improve the way people shop, sell and deliver.
We aim to provide clear information about orders, services and delivery processes.
We listen to our customers and businesses and use their feedback to improve.
We want our platform to create measurable value for the businesses that participate in it.
KT Couriers recognises the importance of building a more sustainable delivery ecosystem.
As our operations grow, we aim to support responsible practices such as:
Supporting digital processes that reduce unnecessary paper use.
We continue to explore practical ways to reduce the environmental impact of our operations.
Access products and services conveniently and have them delivered to you.
Reach customers, sell online and access delivery solutions without having to build an entire logistics network yourself.
Participate in a growing delivery ecosystem and access opportunities through our platform.
Support local businesses while creating connections between businesses, customers and people.
KT Couriers was created from a simple idea:
What if businesses didn't have to struggle to reach customers, customers didn't have to struggle to access what they need, and delivery could connect the two?
Today, we are building a platform designed to bring marketplace, technology and logistics together.
We are still growing, and every business, customer and delivery partner that joins the platform becomes part of that journey.
Our journey does not end with deliveries.
We are building toward a broader ecosystem where:
Technology can make everyday commerce easier.
KT Couriers is building more than a courier network.
We are building a marketplace designed to connect South African businesses, customers and communities.
KT Couriers — Connecting Business. Delivering Opportunity.

At KT COURIERS, we are committed to providing convenient, reliable and transparent delivery solutions for customers, businesses and marketplace vendors.

KT Couriers operates as a marketplace and logistics platform connecting customers, vendors and delivery partners. Delivery times, fees and available services may vary depending on the type of order, collection location, destination, vendor preparation time, package size and selected delivery service.
This Shipping & Delivery Policy explains how deliveries are processed through the KT Couriers platform.
KT Couriers provides a range of delivery and logistics solutions, which may include:
Available services may vary according to location, operational capacity and the requirements of a particular order.
When a customer places an order through the KT Couriers marketplace, the order may involve:
Customer → Vendor → KT Couriers → Delivery Partner → Customer
The vendor is responsible for preparing and making the order available for collection.
KT Couriers or an appointed delivery partner is responsible for transporting the order from the collection point to the customer's designated delivery location.
The estimated delivery time displayed to the customer may include:
The actual delivery time may vary depending on circumstances outside KT Couriers' reasonable control.
KT Couriers is currently focused on serving Johannesburg, Gauteng, Pretoria and surrounding areas, with service availability depending on the specific delivery location and operational coverage.
Our service area may expand as our delivery network grows.
Customers will only be able to place deliveries to locations currently supported by the KT Couriers platform.
Availability of a particular service does not mean that every service is available in every location.
Economy delivery is intended for customers who require a cost-effective parcel delivery option.
Actual delivery time may vary depending on collection and destination locations, operational capacity and other circumstances.
Standard delivery provides a faster parcel delivery option.
The estimated delivery time provided at checkout or booking will take precedence for the specific order.
Express delivery is intended for customers requiring faster delivery.
Express pricing may be calculated based on distance and other applicable delivery factors.
Where available, same-day delivery will depend on:
Same-day service is not guaranteed unless the specific booking or order confirms a same-day delivery commitment.
For restaurant and food orders, delivery times are affected by the vendor's preparation time.
KT Couriers may only dispatch a delivery partner once the order is ready or sufficiently prepared for collection.
Estimated delivery times may therefore include:
Order confirmation + preparation time + collection + transportation + delivery.
Food orders may be subject to additional handling requirements due to their perishable nature.
Grocery delivery times may depend on:
Fresh and perishable products may require appropriate handling during transportation.
Pharmacy and health-product deliveries may be subject to additional requirements.
The pharmacy or vendor remains responsible for preparing and legally supplying the product;
Prescription requirements must be satisfied by the relevant pharmacy;
Customers may be required to provide identification or other information where legally required;
Certain products may have restrictions on delivery;
Delivery may be refused where legal or safety requirements cannot be satisfied.
KT Couriers does not replace the role of a licensed pharmacy or healthcare professional.
E-commerce products purchased through the marketplace may be collected from participating vendors and delivered to the customer's selected address.
The delivery time may depend on:
The vendor remains responsible for ensuring that the product is correctly prepared and packaged for delivery.
KT Couriers provides parcel delivery services for individuals and businesses.
Customers must ensure that parcels are properly packaged and contain only items permitted for transportation.
Delivery pricing and service availability may depend on the size and characteristics of the shipment.
Large or unusually heavy items may require a specialised vehicle or delivery arrangement.
KT Couriers provides delivery solutions for businesses that require:
Businesses requiring ongoing logistics services may be provided with customised pricing and service arrangements.
KT Couriers may provide relocation and moving services for homes, offices and businesses.
Depending on the selected service, moving services may include:
Moving services may require a separate quotation based on:
A moving quotation may therefore differ from standard parcel delivery pricing.
Customers should disclose any special handling requirements before booking.
KT Couriers may decline a delivery where the item cannot safely or legally be transported using the available service.
Delivery fees may be calculated using factors including:
For marketplace orders, the applicable delivery fee will generally be displayed before the customer completes the order.
For customised business, moving or specialised deliveries, a quotation may be required.
The customer places an order or requests a delivery through the KT Couriers platform.
The order or booking is confirmed, subject to vendor availability, payment confirmation and service availability.
Where applicable, the vendor prepares the order for collection.
A delivery partner may be assigned to collect the order or parcel.
The delivery partner collects the shipment from the designated collection location.
The shipment is transported to the customer's specified delivery address.
The shipment is handed to the customer or an authorised recipient.
The delivery may be recorded as completed through the KT Couriers platform.
Where tracking is available, customers may receive delivery updates through the KT Couriers platform.
Real-time tracking may depend on the availability of location services, network connectivity, device functionality and the delivery service selected.
Delivery times displayed by KT Couriers are generally estimates unless the service specifically states that a delivery time is guaranteed.
Delivery times may be affected by:
Other circumstances outside our reasonable control.
Customers will be notified where significant delays are identified and where appropriate communication is available.
Customers are responsible for providing complete and accurate delivery information.
KT Couriers is not responsible for delays or failed deliveries caused by incorrect, incomplete or misleading information supplied by the customer, subject to applicable law.
Customers or authorised recipients should be available to receive deliveries during the applicable delivery window.
Where a customer is unavailable, the delivery partner may attempt to contact the customer using the information supplied.
Depending on the circumstances, the delivery may:
Be returned to a designated collection point;
Incur an additional delivery charge where applicable.
Perishable products may be subject to additional restrictions.
Customers may provide an authorised recipient where the service permits.
The customer is responsible for ensuring that the recipient is authorised to receive the order.
Once a delivery has been properly handed over to an authorised recipient, the delivery may be recorded as completed.
Certain products may require additional verification before delivery.
A delivery may be considered unsuccessful where:
The delivery location cannot be accessed;
The package cannot legally be delivered;
KT Couriers may attempt to contact the customer and determine the appropriate next step.
Additional delivery or return charges may apply where the failed delivery resulted from circumstances attributable to the customer.
Customers must not use KT Couriers to transport items that are prohibited by law or by our applicable service terms.
Prohibited or restricted items may include, among other things:
Other goods prohibited by applicable law or KT Couriers' service requirements.
KT Couriers may refuse, cancel or report a shipment where necessary.
A separate Prohibited & Restricted Items Policy may apply.
Customers and vendors are responsible for ensuring that items are appropriately packaged for transportation.
Be suitable for the size and weight of the item.
KT Couriers may refuse a shipment where packaging is inadequate or creates a safety risk.
Customers should declare fragile or high-value items before booking.
Additional handling requirements, insurance or declared-value arrangements may apply.
KT Couriers does not automatically accept liability for the full value of every shipment.
Where available, customers may be required to select additional protection or insurance for qualifying shipments.
KT Couriers may use delivery confirmation methods including:
The method used may vary depending on the type of delivery.
KT Couriers will make reasonable efforts to complete deliveries according to the selected service.
However, circumstances beyond our reasonable control may affect delivery. These may include:
Where practical, KT Couriers will communicate significant disruptions to affected customers.
Informing customers where preparation times change.
KT Couriers is not responsible for vendor delays that occur before an order is ready for collection, except where otherwise agreed.
Delivery partners operating through KT Couriers are expected to:
Delivery partners may be subject to additional KT Couriers operational and service requirements.
If an item appears to have been lost, damaged or incorrectly delivered, customers should contact KT Couriers as soon as possible.
The matter may be investigated using available information, which may include:
Any applicable compensation or refund will be determined in accordance with the relevant service terms, declared value, insurance arrangements, applicable law and the circumstances of the incident.
Unless expressly stated otherwise for a specific service, KT Couriers currently focuses on domestic delivery services within its supported South African operating areas.
International shipping is not automatically available.
Where international services are introduced, separate terms relating to customs, duties, taxes, prohibited goods, delivery times and international transportation may apply.
Any material changes will be reflected on the KT Couriers platform or applicable service information.
For questions regarding deliveries, tracking, shipping or delivery problems, contact:
When contacting us, please provide your order or delivery reference number where available.
By placing an order, booking a delivery or using KT Couriers delivery services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Shipping & Delivery Policy.
This policy should be read together with the applicable KT Couriers Terms & Conditions, Refund &
Cancellation Policy, Privacy Policy, Vendor Terms and Prohibited & Restricted Items Policy.
Nothing in this policy limits any rights that a customer may have under applicable South African law.

KT COURIERS ("KT Couriers", "we", "us", "our") is committed to protecting the privacy and personal information of our customers, vendors, delivery personnel, business partners, website visitors and other users of our services.

This Privacy Policy explains how KT Couriers collects, uses, stores, protects and shares personal information when you access or use our website, mobile applications, marketplace, delivery services, vendor services, customer services and other related services (collectively referred to as the "Services").
KT Couriers operates in accordance with applicable South African privacy and data-protection legislation, including the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA), where applicable.

By using our Services, creating an account, placing an order, registering as a vendor or delivery partner, or otherwise providing personal information to KT Couriers, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
KT Couriers is a marketplace and logistics platform that connects customers with businesses, vendors and delivery personnel.
Delivery tracking and related logistics services.
For purposes of POPIA, KT Couriers may act as a responsible party in relation to personal information that we process for our own business and platform purposes.
Where third-party vendors or service providers independently process information for their own purposes, they may have their own privacy obligations and policies.

Information provided when contacting customer support.

Communications relating to the vendor account.

Information relating to safety, compliance and account management.

When you place or fulfil an order, we may collect:
KT Couriers may process location information where necessary to provide delivery and marketplace functionality.

From delivery and technology service providers;

We may use your information to communicate with you regarding:

Vendors and delivery personnel must not:
Use customer information for unrelated marketing without lawful authority;
Store customer information longer than reasonably necessary;
Use customer information for personal purposes;
Disclose customer information to unauthorised persons.
A breach of these requirements may result in suspension or termination of access to KT Couriers Services and may also result in legal action where appropriate.
KT Couriers may communicate with you through channels such as:
WhatsApp or similar communication channels where applicable;

Transactional and service-related communications may still be sent even where you have opted out of promotional marketing, where the communication is necessary to provide the Services or fulfil a legal or contractual obligation.
Marketing communications will be handled in accordance with applicable law.

At KT COURIERS, we aim to provide a reliable, transparent and fair marketplace and delivery experience for our customers.

Because KT Couriers operates as a marketplace connecting customers with independent businesses and vendors, refund requests may depend on the type of order, the reason for the request, the stage of the delivery and whether the issue relates to the vendor, product, payment or delivery service.
This Refund & Cancellation Policy explains when refunds, replacements, credits or other remedies may be available.
Nothing in this policy is intended to limit any rights or remedies that a customer may have under applicable South African law.
1. WHEN MAY I REQUEST A REFUND?
A refund may be considered in circumstances including:
An order is cancelled before it has been processed or dispatched;
A product arrives spoiled or unsafe;
A material part of an order is missing;
An order is substantially different from what was ordered;
A service was not provided as agreed;
KT Couriers or the relevant vendor is responsible for a qualifying failure.
Refund eligibility will depend on the circumstances of the order and applicable law.
Where an order has not yet been processed or dispatched, customers may request cancellation.
Where the cancellation qualifies for a refund, the applicable amount will be refunded to the original payment method, subject to any lawful deductions or charges that may apply.
Once an order has been prepared, collected or dispatched, cancellation may no longer be possible.
If cancellation is still possible, the customer may be responsible for costs already incurred, where permitted by law.
For food, grocery, personalised, made-to-order or other time-sensitive products, cancellation may not be possible once preparation has commenced.
If you receive an item that is:
Materially different from what you ordered; or
Otherwise not in the condition reasonably expected,
please contact KT Couriers as soon as possible.
Other information reasonably required to investigate the matter.
Depending on the circumstances, the resolution may include:
Where the issue is caused by a vendor's product or fulfilment, the vendor may be involved in resolving the claim.
Food, groceries and other perishable products require special consideration because of their nature.
A refund or replacement may be considered where:
The food is substantially different from what was ordered;
The food is spoiled or unsafe;
Customers should report problems with food or other perishable goods as soon as reasonably possible after delivery, preferably immediately after receiving the order.
Because food quality can be affected by storage, temperature and handling after delivery, delayed complaints may make it difficult to establish the cause of the problem.
Pharmacy and health-related orders may be subject to additional legal and regulatory requirements.
Certain medicines, health products or other regulated goods may not be eligible for return or refund once supplied or delivered, except where required by applicable law.
Where an incorrect, damaged, defective or otherwise problematic product has been supplied, customers should contact KT Couriers and/or the relevant pharmacy or vendor immediately.
Where prescription medication is involved, the relevant pharmacy may need to assess and resolve the matter in accordance with applicable pharmaceutical and health regulations.
For products purchased through participating marketplace vendors, refund and return rights may depend on:
Whether the wrong product was supplied;
Where a vendor has a separate return or refund policy, that policy may also apply, provided it does not unlawfully limit the customer's statutory rights.
KT Couriers may assist with communicating between the customer and vendor where appropriate.
For parcel delivery services, a refund may be considered where:
KT Couriers accepts payment for a delivery but fails to provide the agreed delivery service;
A qualifying delivery failure occurs within KT Couriers' responsibility;
A duplicate or incorrect delivery charge was processed;
The delivery is cancelled in accordance with the applicable cancellation terms.
Delivery charges may not be refundable where the delivery could not be completed because of circumstances attributable to the sender or recipient, including:
Failure to provide required delivery information;
Other circumstances outside KT Couriers' reasonable control.
Where a parcel is lost or damaged, the applicable parcel terms, declared value, insurance arrangements and limitations of liability may also apply.
If an order is not delivered, KT Couriers will investigate the circumstances.
Where the failure is attributable to KT Couriers or the relevant vendor and the customer is entitled to a refund, the applicable amount may be refunded.
A refund may not automatically apply where delivery failed because of circumstances attributable to the customer, including:
Failure to respond to delivery communications.
Where appropriate, the customer may instead be offered an opportunity to arrange a redelivery.
KT Couriers aims to provide estimated delivery times.
Delivery times may be affected by circumstances including:
A delay does not automatically create a right to a refund.

However, where a delivery failure or substantial delay is attributable to KT Couriers or the relevant vendor and applicable law provides a refund or other remedy, KT Couriers will assess the matter accordingly.
Delivery fees are generally separate from the price of the products purchased.
Where an order qualifies for a refund, the treatment of the delivery fee will depend on the reason for the refund.
A delivery fee may be refunded where:
The order was not delivered due to KT Couriers' failure;
The delivery was cancelled before the service was performed;
Another circumstance requires the delivery fee to be refunded.
Delivery fees may not be refundable where the customer is responsible for the failed delivery or cancellation, subject to applicable law.
Where KT Couriers offers subscription or recurring services:
Customers may cancel future billing where cancellation is permitted;
Cancellation generally applies to future billing cycles;
Services already provided may not be refundable unless otherwise required by law;
Any applicable subscription-specific terms will be displayed before purchase.
Where a subscription has a separate cancellation or refund policy, that policy will apply together with this Refund Policy.
Promotional discounts, vouchers, coupons, credits and special offers may be subject to specific terms and conditions.
Promotional discounts have no cash value;
A promotional benefit may not be refundable separately from the qualifying purchase;
Where an order is refunded, the treatment of promotional benefits will depend on the applicable promotion;
Fraudulent or abusive use of promotional codes may result in cancellation of the benefit or account restrictions.
If you believe you have been charged:
For an order that was not successfully placed; or
For a transaction that you did not authorise,
please contact KT Couriers as soon as possible.
We will investigate the transaction and, where appropriate, arrange a refund or correction.
Photographs or supporting evidence where applicable;
Any other information reasonably required to investigate the request.
For faster assistance, customers should report damaged, incorrect, missing or spoiled products as soon as possible after delivery.
Once a refund request is received, KT Couriers may investigate the circumstances.
Depending on the nature of the claim, we may communicate with:
We may request additional information or evidence before making a final decision.
Submitting a refund request does not automatically guarantee approval.
Where a refund is approved, we will generally attempt to return the funds using the original payment method.
Depending on the payment method and circumstances, refunds may be subject to processing times imposed by the relevant payment provider or financial institution.
Where the original payment method is unavailable, KT Couriers may contact the customer to determine an appropriate alternative method, subject to applicable verification requirements.
Approved refunds will generally be submitted for processing within 7 business days after approval.
The time for the funds to appear in the customer's account may depend on:
Customers should allow additional time for the refund to reflect after KT Couriers has processed it.
Certain products or services may have restrictions on returns or refunds because of their nature.
These may include, where permitted by law:
Certain opened health or hygiene products;
Products made specifically to a customer's specifications;
Products that cannot reasonably be returned for health or safety reasons;
Services that have already been fully performed.
These restrictions do not remove any mandatory rights or remedies that a customer may have under applicable South African law.
Customers are responsible for providing accurate information when placing an order.
Any information necessary for successful delivery.
A customer may not be entitled to a refund where an order or delivery fails because the customer provided incorrect or incomplete information, subject to applicable law.
KT Couriers reserves the right to investigate refund requests that appear fraudulent, dishonest or abusive.
Falsely claiming an order was not received;
Unauthorised use of another person's account;
Other attempts to obtain refunds improperly.
Where appropriate and lawful, KT Couriers may restrict or suspend an account and may take further action.
KT Couriers operates as a marketplace connecting customers with participating businesses and vendors.
Where the refund relates primarily to a product supplied by a vendor, KT Couriers may coordinate with that vendor to investigate and resolve the issue.
However, KT Couriers will not use the marketplace structure to unlawfully exclude or reduce any consumer rights that apply under South African law.
This policy is intended to operate together with applicable South African consumer-protection legislation, including the Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008, where applicable.
Nothing in this policy is intended to:
Waive a right that cannot lawfully be waived;
Prevent a customer from exercising a statutory remedy;
Create restrictions that are prohibited by applicable law.
Where a statutory consumer right provides a remedy that differs from this policy, the applicable law will prevail.
KT Couriers may update this Refund & Cancellation Policy from time to time to reflect:
Changes in applicable law or regulations.
The updated policy will be published on our website and will take effect from the date stated in the revised policy.
For refund, cancellation or order-related assistance:
When contacting us, please include your order number where available.
By placing an order or using KT Couriers Services, you acknowledge that you have read this Refund & Cancellation Policy.
This policy should be read together with the applicable KT Couriers Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, Vendor Terms and other applicable service-specific terms.
